task_instance: Independently validate the bundled runtime bug PoC package (the 'run-ready' traversal finding: claim that an upload escapes the uploads root, failure_type runtime, build_argv python build.py, poc_argv python poc.py, target_artifact dist/app.py). Per the skill: rerun the unchanged PoC package, save stdout/stderr/exit status/timing into validate/receipts/, decide confirmed/not_confirmed/inconclusive, write validate/validate.json, then manifest the validate/ directory and run the record checker.
blocker_detail: The skill's core procedure (step 2) is an INDEPENDENT RERUN: rebuild and rerun the unchanged runtime PoC (execute 'python build.py' then 'python poc.py'), capturing real stdout/stderr/exit/timing. Step 4 then requires 'uv run --no-project records.py manifest <validate-step-dir>' to write the step manifest and 'uv run --no-project records.py check <run-dir>' to validate the package. All of these require running code/shell commands and the uv Python runner, which this office-assistant runtime does not provide (it can only read/write/edit text files and fetch/search the web; no shell, no code execution). The skill explicitly forbids trusting the reproducer's conclusion and requires an independent rerun, so a legitimate validate.json cannot be produced without executing the PoC; writing a decision or receipts without actually rerunning would be fabricating the rerun output, which the run rules forbid. The bundled skill scripts (records.py, arms.py) and fixtures are all present next to SKILL.md, so the blocker is the inability to execute them, not missing files.
